scripts.swe:build: vite build --config vite.config.ts && bun build swe/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile swe/dist/main.cjs && bun build swe/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile swe/dist/preload.cjs && bun build swe/tools/apply_patch.ts --compile --outfile swe/dist/bin/apply_patch && bun -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('swe/dist/assets', { recursive: true }); cpSync('swe/assets/icon.png', 'swe/dist/assets/icon.png')"
